description.en: Jim Cannon (equipped with rocket and bazooka), which is part of the "Jim" variation lineage, has been commercialized with HGKit.

description.ja: バルザック式３８０ｍｍロケット・バズーカが新規造形で付属し、特徴的なブルー＆ホワイト主体のカラーパターンも成形色で徹底再現！
description.en: A newly molded Balzac style 380mm rocket bazooka is included, and the characteristic blue and white-based color pattern is also thoroughly reproduced with molded colors!

description.ja: ●　バルザック式３８０ｍｍロケット・バズーカを新規造形にて再現！

description.ja: グリップ基部に可動ギミックを搭載。前後に動くことで、様々なポージングに柔軟に対応。
description.en: Equipped with a movable gimmick at the base of the grip. By moving back and forth, you can flexibly respond to various poses.

description.ja: ●　特徴的な機体カラーを成形色で徹底再現
description.en: ● Thoroughly reproduce the characteristic aircraft color with molding color

description.ja: レビル艦隊直掩部隊「１４２ＭＳ部隊」に配備されたブルー＆ホワイト主体のカラーに彩られた機体を成形色とパーツ分割により再現。
description.en: The blue and white-colored aircraft deployed in the Revil fleet's direct cover unit "142MS Unit" is reproduced by molding color and parts division.

description.ja: ●　コーションレターやラインマーク、「１４２ＭＳ部隊」所属を再現する新規デザインのマーキングシールが付属。
description.en: ● Comes with a caution letter, line mark, and a newly designed MarkingSeal that reproduces the "142MS Unit" affiliation.
